d: Ahead of the Congress Insaaf Rally in Sangrur featuring Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge, Congress Punjab in-charge Sachin Pilot launched a blistering attack on the ruling Aam Aadmi Party government. Pilot accused the AAP of betraying the trust of Punjab's voters, pushing the border state into financial distress, rampant corruption, and a severe drug crisis. Highlighting the exit of several AAP lawmakers as proof of a "sinking ship," Pilot warned the local administration against any attempts to disrupt the democratic gathering.
